flashcards.q: How is card networks used in Fintech?
flashcards.a: PAYMENT SYSTEMS & NETWORKS Framework: The Payment Value Chain Model (Acquirer → Processor → Issuer → Cardholder) - Acquirer banks onboard merchants and facilitate transaction acceptance. - Payment processors route transaction data between acquirers and issuers. - Issuer banks authenticate and authorize cardholders’ transactions. - Card networks (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX) provide the switching infrastructure.

flashcards.q: How should zero Trust not be handled in Fintech?
flashcards.a: DATA PRIVACY & CYBERSECURITY IN FINTECH Framework: The Zero Trust Security Model - Principle: “Never trust, always verify” for every access request. - Components: Micro-segmentation, multi-factor authentication (MFA), continuous monitoring. - Encryption: End-to-end encryption (AES-256), homomorphic encryption for secure computation on encrypted data. - Incident response: NIST Cybersecurity Framework phases—Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, Recover.
